Survival basics

Your first day: make tools, then build a small home

Start with wood, stone and food, make basic gathering tools, then choose a resource-accessible spot with fewer passing players for a small home. Gather materials before building so you do not run out halfway. Once you have storage, take only essentials outside and return to deposit a good haul. Invest in expensive gear and major expansion after gathering and storage are reliable.
